rationale:
The text sets three obligations for `ValidationContext.read_snapshot`. It must read the node once. It must return the contents together with their fingerprint. It must record that same fingerprint in the dependency list. The tests cover all three. I judged this from the supplied test source and did not request implementation source.

- **Single read.**
  - `direct_reads_return_complete_unicode_contents_and_snapshots` asserts the graph's `reads` log is `[1, 1]` after one `read_snapshot` and one `read`. So `read_snapshot` made exactly one underlying read.
  - `snapshots_record_exact_reads_and_retain_distinct_versions` asserts `reads == [1, 1, 1, 2]` across its read, `read_snapshot`, read and failing read calls. That also shows `read_snapshot` made one read.
- **Contents and fingerprint returned.**
  - `direct_reads_return_complete_unicode_contents_and_snapshots` runs on an empty string and on a large multi-byte Unicode string. It asserts `snapshot.content.format() == original` and `snapshot.fingerprint == fp(original)`.
  - It then changes the stored contents and asserts the snapshot still holds the original.
  - `snapshots_record_exact_reads_and_retain_distinct_versions` asserts `read_snapshot(...).fingerprint == fp("before")`.
- **Same fingerprint recorded in the dependency list.**
  - `direct_reads_return_complete_unicode_contents_and_snapshots` asserts `dependencies() == [Dependency::Node(1, fp(original))]` straight after `read_snapshot`.
  - `snapshots_record_exact_reads_and_retain_distinct_versions` asserts the final dependencies are `[Node(1, fp("before")), Node(1, fp("after"))]`. This shows the snapshot's fingerprint matches an earlier recorded one without a duplicate entry. It also shows later content changes are recorded as new entries.
  - It also asserts the finished record's dependencies match.

The text says nothing about error behavior beyond the `Result` signature, so there is no error obligation to test. `public_exports_match_the_appendix` is a signature and export check and adds no behavioral coverage. I found no unmet obligation and no marking gap.

text: Read a node once and return both its contents and their fingerprint. Record the same fingerprint in the dependency list.
